context: Mizora contacts the party via a projecting diabolical circle to report that one of Zariel’s devils — a powerful asset of hers — has been captured by the Absolute’s cult and is being held in Moonrise Towers. Wyll is not with you, and Mizora bluntly warns that under the infernal terms of their pact, if Wyll fails or refuses, he will be punished — transformed into a lemure and cast into Avernus. She orders the party to rescue the captive and will answer questions (for example, how it was taken), but she resists ending the pact before the mission is done. Her tone is flippant and mocking, but there’s a clear desperation behind the threat, so compliance and negotiation are the only real options.
